chapter_en: Chapter 32: Selection to a vacancy and joining a clerical section

units.chapter_en: Chapter 32: Selection to a vacancy and joining a clerical section
units.title: 选缺参房总纲：以官爻为主、世象为凭；官员选缺及吏典参房皆把官爻及世详，此二象内如有一爻犯月破旬空者官不能得此缺吏不能参此房；应动兄兴冲克世，世纵不空若被应动克世或兄弟动来克世必有同袍抢夺

rule.yi: 官员选缺、吏典参房，都以官爻和世爻为主来细看：这两个象里只要有一个遇到月破或旬空，官员就得不到这个缺，吏就不能参这个房。世爻即使不空，如果被发动的应爻、或发动的兄弟克了世爻，一定有同僚来抢夺，要提防兄弟兴旺、竞争激烈。
rule.en: For an official selected to a vacancy and a clerk joining a section, take the Pressure line and the Self line as the chief and examine them in detail: if either of these two images falls in Month-break or the ten-day Void, the official cannot obtain the vacancy and the clerk cannot join the section. Even if the Self is not Void, if the Other moves to control the Self, or Peer moves to control the Self, there will surely be colleagues scrambling for it, and one must be on guard against Peer flourishing and the competition being strong.

yi: 以官爻为主要看的，以世爻为凭据。
en: Take the Pressure line as the chief to be looked at, and the Self image as the ground.

zh: 官员选缺及吏典参房，皆把官爻及世详，
应动兄兴冲克世，同胞扰阻却提防。
yi: 官员选缺、吏典参房，都要拿官爻和世爻来细看；
应爻发动、兄弟兴旺，冲克世爻的，要提防同辈的人来骚扰、阻碍。
en: For officials selected to a vacancy and clerks joining a section, the Pressure line and the Self are examined in detail;
if the Other moves or Peer flourishes and clashes with or controls the Self, beware of the disturbance and obstruction of one's fellows.

zh: 官僚选缺及吏典参房，皆把官爻与世爻为主，此二象内如有一爻犯月破旬空者，官不能得此缺，吏不能参此房。
世纵不空，若被应动克世、或兄弟动来克世，必有同袍抢夺，却要提防兄兴，竞争强。
yi: 官僚选缺和吏典参房，都以官爻和世爻为主；这两个象里如果有一个犯月破或旬空，官员就得不到这个缺，吏就不能参这个房。
世爻即使不空，如果被发动的应爻克世、或者兄弟发动来克世，一定有同僚来抢夺，更要提防兄弟兴旺、竞争激烈。
en: For officials selected to a vacancy and clerks joining a section, the Pressure line and the Self line are taken as the chief; if one of these two images falls in Month-break or the ten-day Void, the official cannot obtain this vacancy and the clerk cannot join this section.

Even if the Self is not Void, if the Other moves to control the Self, or Peer moves to control the Self, there will surely be colleagues scrambling for it, and one must be on guard against Peer flourishing and the competition being strong.

note.yi: 「选缺」是候选的官员被选派到一个空缺的官职上；「参房」是吏典进入衙门里的某一房（吏、户、礼、兵、刑、工等房）当差。「月破」是被月建冲破的爻，「旬空」是落在旬空的爻（见术语表）。「同胞」「同袍」都指同辈、同僚，也就是来争这个缺的人（兄弟爻）。「应动克世」书里连写，这里按「应爻发动而克世」读。这一条与黄金策求馆「兄兴临应，决多同类侵谋」（HJC.37）取同一个关系：兄弟发动，有同行来争。
note.en: 'Xuan que' is a candidate official being appointed to a vacant post, and 'can fang' is a clerk entering one of the sections of a yamen (the Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice or Works section and so on) to work. 'Month-break' is a line broken by the clash of the Month, and 'ten-day Void' is a line falling on the Void of its ten-day week (see the glossary). 'Tongbao' and 'tongpao' both mean fellows and colleagues, that is the people who compete for the vacancy (the Peer line). 'Ying dong ke shi' is written run together in the book and is read here as 'the Other moves and controls the Self'. This entry takes the same relation as 'if Peer flourishes and rests on the Other, many of one's own kind will scheme to take it' in the Huangjin Ce on seeking a school post (HJC.37): when Peer moves, people in the same line come to compete.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 32: Selection to a vacancy and joining a clerical section
units.title: 选缺参房：世爻若遇空冲绝费尽勤劳怎得昌，不遇六冲官有气稳膺美秩姓名扬；世若变为绝地或被日主来冲或卜六冲之卦纵去谋为决难成就，世象不空官爻不陷、应与兄爻纵动不来克世所求必遂并不更张

rule.yi: 世爻如果遇到空、冲、绝，费尽辛勤劳苦，又怎么能兴旺？不遇六冲、官有气，就稳稳地得到好的官位，姓名远扬。世爻如果变到绝地，或者被日辰来冲，或者卜得六冲的卦，即使去谋求，也一定难以成功；世爻不空、官爻不陷，应爻和兄爻即使发动，只要不来克世，所求的一定遂意，也不会更改。
rule.en: If the Self meets Void, clash or extinction, however much toil one spends, how can one prosper? If one does not meet a six-clash and the star of office has qi, one will securely receive a fine rank and one's name will be known. If the Self changes into a place of extinction, or is clashed by the Day, or the hexagram cast is a six-clash, then even if one goes about scheming it will surely be hard to succeed; if the Self image is not Void and the Pressure line is not sunk, then even if the Other and the Peer line move, as long as they do not come to control the Self, what one seeks will surely be attained and there will be no change.

zh: 世爻若遇空冲绝，费尽勤劳怎得昌，
不遇六冲官有气，稳膺美秩姓名扬。
yi: 世爻如果遇到空、冲、绝，费尽辛勤劳苦，又怎么能兴旺？
不遇六冲、官有气，就稳稳地得到好的官位，姓名远扬。
en: If the Self meets Void, clash or extinction, however much toil one spends, how can one prosper?
If one does not meet a six-clash and the star of office has qi, one will securely receive a fine rank and one's name will be known.

zh: 世若变为绝地、或被日主来冲、或卜六冲之卦，纵去谋为，决难成就。
世象不空官爻不陷、应与兄爻纵动、不来克世，所求必逐，并不更张。
yi: 世爻如果变到绝地，或者被日辰来冲，或者卜得六冲的卦，即使去谋求，也一定难以成功。
世爻不空、官爻不陷，应爻和兄爻即使发动，只要不来克世，所求的一定遂意，也不会更改。
en: If the Self changes into a place of extinction, or is clashed by the Day, or the hexagram cast is a six-clash, then even if one goes about scheming it will surely be hard to succeed.

If the Self image is not Void and the Pressure line is not sunk, then even if the Other and the Peer line move, as long as they do not come to control the Self, what one seeks will surely be attained and there will be no change.

note.yi: 「美秩」是好的官职；「日主」是日辰；「逐」疑是「遂」，「所求必逐」译作「所求必遂」；「并不更张」是不会再更改。这一条是上一条（EL.76）的另一面：世爻自己空冲绝、卦是六冲，和应动、兄动来克世，是两类不同的阻碍。
note.en: 'Meizhi' is a fine official rank; 'rizhu' is the Day; the 'zhu' of 'suo qiu bi zhu' is presumably 'sui', to be fulfilled, and it is translated 'what one seeks will surely be attained'; 'bing bu gengzhang' is that there will be no further change. This entry is the other side of the previous one (EL.76): the Self itself being Void, clashed or extinct, and the hexagram being a six-clash, are one kind of obstacle, and the Other or Peer moving to control the Self is another.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 32: Selection to a vacancy and joining a clerical section
units.title: 选缺参房：参房获利宜财旺鬼象休来克世、选缺求名愁福德随官入墓恐遭殃；论参房者与选缺不同，得官与财旺定然所得非常，鬼克世身难逃罪责；论选缺者亦要官兴最嫌子动，鬼克世身不须畏忌，但遇随官入墓恐罹灾患

rule.yi: 参房求利，适宜财爻旺相，官鬼之象不要来克世爻；选缺求名，怕的是福德（子孙）发动，以及随着官爻入墓，恐怕遭殃。参房和选缺看法不同：参房如果官和财都旺相，所得一定不寻常，官鬼克世身，难逃罪责；选缺也要官爻兴旺，最嫌子孙发动，官鬼克世身反而不必畏忌；只是遇到随官入墓，恐怕遭灾患。
rule.en: For joining a section and seeking gain, Wealth should be thriving and the Pressure image must not come to control the Self; for selection to a vacancy and seeking a name, what is dreaded is Output, the fortune virtue, moving, and following the star of office into the tomb, for fear of calamity. Judging joining a section differs from judging a selection to a vacancy: for joining a section, if the star of office and Wealth are both thriving, what is gained will surely be extraordinary, and if Pressure controls the Self or the Body one cannot escape blame; for a selection to a vacancy the star of office must also flourish and Output moving is most disliked, whereas Pressure controlling the Self or the Body need not be feared; but if one meets following the star of office into the tomb, calamity is to be feared.

zh: 参房获利宜财旺，鬼象休来克世方，
选缺求名愁福德，随官入墓恐遭殃。
yi: 参房求利，适宜财爻旺相，官鬼之象不要来克世爻；
选缺求名，怕的是福德（子孙）发动；随着官爻入墓，恐怕要遭殃。
en: For joining a section and seeking gain, Wealth should be thriving, and the Pressure image must not come to control the Self;
for selection to a vacancy and seeking a name, what is dreaded is Output, the fortune virtue; to follow the star of office into the tomb is to risk calamity.

zh: 论参房者，与选缺不同，若得官与财旺，定然所得非常。
鬼克世身难逃罪贵，论选缺者，亦要官兴，最嫌子动，鬼克世身，不须畏忌。
但遇随官入墓，恐罹灾患。
yi: 论参房和选缺不同：参房如果官和财都旺相，所得一定不寻常。
官鬼克制世身，就难逃罪责；论选缺的，也要官爻兴旺，最嫌子孙发动，官鬼克制世身，反而不必畏忌。
只是遇到随官入墓，恐怕要遭灾患。
en: To judge joining a section is different from judging a selection to a vacancy: if the star of office and Wealth are both thriving, what is gained will surely be extraordinary.

If Pressure controls the Self or the Body one cannot escape blame; for a selection to a vacancy the star of office must also flourish and Output moving is most disliked, whereas Pressure controlling the Self or the Body need not be feared.
But if one meets following the star of office into the tomb, calamity is to be feared.

note.yi: 「罪贵」疑是「罪责」，译作「罪责」。「世身」是世爻和卦身（见术语表）。「福德」是子孙。「随官入墓」是世爻跟着官爻一起入墓，增删卜易对它另有说法（ZS.06：古以随官入墓为凶，作者屡试后改说世旺者反升）。参房与选缺要分开看：参房是吏进衙门做事，看财；选缺是官员得缺，看官，所以官鬼克世身，一个是祸，一个不必畏忌——这是据本条上下文读出来的，书里没有另说缘故。
note.en: The 'gui' of 'zui gui' is presumably 'ze', blame, and it is translated 'blame'. 'Shi shen' is the Self line and the Body of the hexagram (see the glossary). 'Fude' is Output. 'Following the star of office into the tomb' is the Self line entering the tomb together with the Pressure line, and the Zengshan Buyi has a different account of it (ZS.06: the old view took following the star of office into the tomb as ominous, but the author after many trials said that a thriving Self on the contrary rises). Joining a section and selection to a vacancy are to be looked at separately: joining a section is a clerk entering a yamen to work and looks at Wealth, while selection to a vacancy is an official obtaining a post and looks at the star of office, so Pressure controlling the Self or Body is calamity for one and need not be feared for the other; this is read from the context of this entry, and the book gives no other reason.
